starter.flow.node.ai-agent.label: AI agent
starter.flow.node.ai-agent.summary: Runs a model turn with a system prompt, tools, and a turn budget.
starter.flow.node.ai-agent.help: Invokes a configured AI provider, optionally exposing a subset of the host's registered tools. Drives a model loop until the turn budget is exhausted or the model emits a final answer. Configure with `provider_id` and (optionally) `system_prompt`, `tools`, and `max_turns`.
starter.flow.node.tool-call.label: Tool call
starter.flow.node.tool-call.summary: Invokes one registered tool by its reverse-DNS id.
starter.flow.node.tool-call.help: Looks up `tool_id` in the host-controlled tool registry and forwards the input payload as JSON. The tool's JSON response becomes the output slot. Use this when you want to invoke a tool deterministically without going through an AI agent.
starter.flow.node.transform.label: Transform
starter.flow.node.transform.summary: Applies a registered pure function to its input.
starter.flow.node.transform.help: Looks up `fn_id` in the host-controlled transform registry and applies it to the input slot. Functions are pure and side-effect-free; this is the node to reach for when you need to reshape, filter, or compute over slot data without I/O.
starter.flow.node.branch.label: Branch
starter.flow.node.branch.summary: Routes propagation down one outgoing edge based on a predicate.
starter.flow.node.branch.help: Evaluates a predicate over its input slot and forwards the token down exactly one of its outgoing edges. Use to express if/else and switch-like flow control without splitting the graph manually.
starter.flow.node.merge.label: Merge
starter.flow.node.merge.summary: Fans multiple upstream slots into a single output.
starter.flow.node.merge.help: Combines values arriving on its input slots according to an explicit wait/combine policy (e.g. all, any, first). Use to join parallel branches before a downstream step.
starter.flow.node.gate.label: Gate
starter.flow.node.gate.summary: Holds propagation until an external approver releases it.
starter.flow.node.gate.help: Pauses the flow at this node and surfaces a review item on the run timeline. An approver releases the gate via the platform's review surface; the run then resumes from the gate's output. Use for verify / approval / human-in-the-loop steps.
starter.flow.node.subflow.label: Subflow
starter.flow.node.subflow.summary: Composes another flow as a single node.
starter.flow.node.subflow.help: The inner flow's input slots become this node's inputs and its output slots become its outputs. Cancellation and the three-level stop propagate across the boundary unchanged. Use to factor reusable pipelines.
starter.flow.node.trigger-explicit.label: Explicit trigger
starter.flow.node.trigger-explicit.summa: Entry node fired by a host-controlled channel.
starter.flow.node.trigger-explicit.help: Waits on a fire channel bound by the host under `channel_id`. Use when an external caller (CLI, REST handler, another flow) needs to start this flow on demand.
starter.flow.node.trigger-event.label: Event trigger
starter.flow.node.trigger-event.summary: Entry node fired when a referenced slot value changes.
starter.flow.node.trigger-event.help: Watches a `slot_ref` and starts the flow whenever the referenced slot's value changes. This is the reactive entry point — use for change-driven pipelines.
starter.flow.node.trigger-schedule.label: Schedule trigger
starter.flow.node.trigger-schedule.summa: Entry node fired by a cron expression.
starter.flow.node.trigger-schedule.help: Starts the flow on a cron schedule, backed by the durable scheduler. Use for periodic or time-of-day pipelines.
starter.flow.node.trigger-webhook.label: Webhook trigger
starter.flow.node.trigger-webhook.summar: Entry node fired by an inbound HTTP request.
starter.flow.node.trigger-webhook.help: Exposes the flow as an HTTP endpoint; the request payload populates the entry slots. Auth is applied by the adapter before the engine sees the call. Use to publish a flow as a service.
starter.flow.node.http-out.label: HTTP request
starter.flow.node.http-out.summary: Issues a single outbound HTTP request.
starter.flow.node.http-out.help: Shapes a request from its input slot, sends it, and emits the response on its output slot. Retry, timeout, and safe-state behaviour come from the node's policy block.
starter.flow.node.log.label: Log
starter.flow.node.log.summary: Emits a structured tracing event with the input value.
starter.flow.node.log.help: Records the input slot as a tracing event under the `starter.flow.log` target at the configured `level` (trace|debug|info|warn|error; defaults to info). Passes the value through to the output slot so downstream nodes can chain.
starter.flow.node.sleep.label: Sleep
starter.flow.node.sleep.summary: Holds propagation for a declared duration.
starter.flow.node.sleep.help: Waits for the configured duration then forwards the input to the output. Cancellation interrupts the wait. Use for back-off, pacing, or simple delays.
